caption:
Never seen a chiropractor before? Mr Turtle was a little nervous too. Here's what actually happens.

Your first visit starts with a proper chat about your symptoms, health history and goals. Then comes an assessment of how you move, joint range and strength, and sometimes reflexes and sensation. Bring any recent scans or reports.

You'll get a clear explanation and a suggested plan, which may include hands-on care, soft tissue work and exercises. Adjustments are one tool, not the whole plan, and your chiropractor will always ask for consent first. Prefer gentler techniques? Just say so. Mild stiffness for a day or so afterwards is common.

Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio work alongside our physios and Pilates team. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
